author: Stahly
description:
The Kromdron are marching out in force. In part 1 of our Khazalite Holds roundup, we unbox the Clangunners, the all-female Valayan Guardians, and the mighty High Kyng Valankrom on his War Throne. You’ll find high-res sprue images for every kit and a full breakdown of all build options, so you know exactly what you’re getting before you commit.

The post Khazalite Holds wave 2 unboxed: Clangunners, Valayan Guardians, and High Kyng Valankrom appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: Khazalite Holds wave 2 unboxed: Clangunners, Valayan Guardians, and High Kyng Valankrom
